title: verify_auth_routing_based_on_session_role
description: Test the splash screen's auth routing logic by simulating different session states: valid client session, valid pro session, null session, and session missing role. Verify that the app navigates to the correct route (/client/feed, /pro/dashboard, /onboarding) accordingly.

title: validate_onboarding_completion_and_navigation
description: Test the onboarding flow by completing the slides and tapping 'Get Started' or 'Skip'. Verify that the onboarding_completed flag is written to Hive prefs and the app navigates to /account-type or /login respectively. Also test Hive write failure and ensure inline error is shown with retry option.

title: test_user_signup_with_role_and_profile_insertion
description: Test user sign up with valid and invalid credentials. Verify that after successful signup, the user profile is inserted with the selected role. Handle errors such as validation failures and unique constraint conflicts, showing appropriate error messages and retry options.

title: test_user_login_with_email_and_google_oauth
description: Test login via email/password and Google OAuth. Verify successful login returns session and routes user based on stored role or onboarding status. Test invalid credentials and ensure error messages are displayed and retry is allowed.

title: verify_complete_profile_update_and_navigation
description: Test profile completion by submitting display name, avatar, and bio. Verify successful update routes client users to /client/interests and pro users to /pro/business-details. Test invalid payloads and ensure validation errors prevent navigation.

title: validate_video_feed_fetch_and_interactions
description: Test fetching approved videos for the TikTok-style feed. Verify videos are rendered and autoplay works. Test liking a video updates like count and animates heart. Simulate network failure and verify offline UI with retry option.

title: test_discover_search_pro_profiles_and_services
description: Test searching and filtering pro profiles and services. Verify results are displayed correctly. Test rate limit exceeded error returns 429 and shows appropriate message to user.

title: test_booking_flow_with_stripe_payment_and_atomic_creation
description: Test the multi-step booking flow including service selection, Stripe payment intent creation, payment confirmation, and atomic booking creation via Edge Function. Verify handling of payment failures and booking status updates.

title: validate_event_ticket_purchase_and_qr_generation
description: Test viewing event details, selecting ticket types, creating Stripe ticket payment intents, confirming payment, and receiving ticket with QR hash. Verify navigation to ticket detail screen and handling of payment failures.

title: test_settings_sign_out_and_notification_preferences
description: Test signing out clears local session and navigates to login. Test updating notification preferences persists on server. Simulate network error on sign out and verify error message is shown and user remains signed in.
